package.author: Yash Jangid
package.description: Local file search and launcher with OCR and semantic search.

en-US.author: Yash Jangid
en-US.description: Local file search and launcher with OCR and semantic search.
en-US.longDescription: Kensaku is an open-source desktop file launcher that indexes file names, document and code text, and text recognised in screenshots, all on the local machine. Searches return instantly without a cloud round-trip, and the same index is exposed to AI agents over MCP or a loopback HTTP server. Full-text extraction covers PDF, Office and other document formats, while optional OCR packs and semantic models download on first use.
en-US.name: Kensaku
en-US.releaseNotes: Fixed an indexing freeze that could stall OCR crawls near 97% when processing large batches of images. Rate-limited memory trims on Windows, replaced a mutex-guarded channel receiver with a condition variable, removed a blocking lock convoy across parallel OCR engines, and raised the single-file OCR timeout budget from 8 to 45 seconds for images and scanned PDFs.

zh-CN.description: 支持 OCR 与语义搜索的本地文件搜索与启动器。
zh-CN.longDescription: Kensaku 是一款开源的桌面文件启动器，在本地机器上索引文件名、文档与代码文本以及截图中识别出的文字。搜索无需云端往返即可即时返回结果，同一套索引还可通过 MCP 或本机回环 HTTP 服务提供给智能体使用。全文抽取覆盖 PDF、Office 等文档格式，OCR 语言包与语义模型在首次使用时按需下载。
